breakdown.description: The centroid point load is replaced by a uniform traction over the hypotenuse
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses FEniCS PointSource to apply the concentrated vertical load of -5000 N at the point (0.5, 0.25) on the y-component of the displacement test function, rather than smearing it as a uniform traction over the hypotenuse. This matches the ground truth's instruction to 'Represent each concentrated load with PointSource on the appropriate displacement component instead of smearing it over an edge.'
